_ad_network_notes: Ad-network placement lesson (2026-08-13): the network caps how many opportunities can be in the ACCEPTED-but-unplaced state at once. Placing three fresh unclaimed offers from list_ad_offers failed with 'can not accept any more opportunities' because prior daily runs had already auto-accepted several offers that were never placed. Fix: place the ALREADY-ACCEPTED opportunity IDs from list_ad_opportunities (status=accepted) directly in the advertisementOpportunity node, since those require no new acceptance. Rank accepted opportunities by payout_per_click_cents, drop any whose send_by is at or before the target send timestamp, and prefer distinct advertisers. Klover (262c) was the highest-paying offer available but existed only as an unclaimed offer, so using it would have hit the accept cap; it was skipped in favor of already-accepted Q3 Advisors, Sprayground, and 1440 Media.
